notes.content: (120 UNITS) The Bachelor of Arts in Theatre ( Link ) provides the opportunity for students to focus on the breadth of theatre studies. The curriculum core requires study in acting, directing, design and production, history, literature and theatre criticism. Students are required to participate in department production activities, including plays, musicals, dance and opera. In addition to the requirements for the major, students must meet all other university requirements for a bachelor’s degree. Please consult the Graduation Requirements for the Bachelor’s Degree section in this catalog for complete information. Students must take THTR 110 to fulfill G.E. Category 1.C Oral Communication. Transfer students may transfer over 2 units of THTR 278B and must take 3 units of THTR 478B . Directing Concentration The Directing concentration ( Link ) prepares students for a career in directing plays and musicals. The curriculum core requires study in acting, directing, design and production, history, literature and theatre criticism. Students are required to participate in department production activities, including plays, musicals, dance and opera. THTR 370B - Intermediate Directing (3) THTR 470A - Advanced Directing I (3) THTR 470B - Advanced Directing II (3) Please use the Articulation Details section to review course combination equivalencies.
notes.contentHtml:
(120 UNITS)

The Bachelor of Arts in Theatre (Link) provides the opportunity for students to focus on the breadth of theatre studies. The curriculum core requires study in acting, directing, design and production, history, literature and theatre criticism. Students are required to participate in department production activities, including plays, musicals, dance and opera.

In addition to the requirements for the major, students must meet all other university requirements for a bachelor’s degree. Please consult the Graduation Requirements for the Bachelor’s Degree section in this catalog for complete information.

Students must take THTR 110 to fulfill G.E. Category 1.C Oral Communication.

Transfer students may transfer over 2 units of THTR 278B and must take 3 units of THTR 478B.

Directing Concentration

The Directing concentration (Link) prepares students for a career in directing plays and musicals. The curriculum core requires study in acting, directing, design and production, history, literature and theatre criticism. Students are required to participate in department production activities, including plays, musicals, dance and opera.

  • THTR 370B - Intermediate Directing (3)
  • THTR 470A - Advanced Directing I (3)
  • THTR 470B - Advanced Directing II (3)

Please use the Articulation Details section to review course combination equivalencies.
